d:
This translation was done by extracting the text using AI, translating it with google translate and then me trying to make sense out of the result. Then I edited it in Paint.

I never did a translation before, don't speak Japanese and English isn't my first language, so don't expect the best work, but I'm pretty confident it's better than the regular MTL slop. Didn't put much work into the editing as I hope this just suffices till we get the official Ottoberg translation.

So far I've only done the first 65 pages, but depending on the reception I will continue. Have every single page already translated in txt files, they just need to be edited.

If there are any mistakes or poor wordings in the translations, please let me know.
